coaching.headline: Objectives beat a near-even kill count: allied objective damage ran 100749 to 18934, and structure takes ran ten to two.

flags.text: Khaimera took Mini Prime, two Fangtooths, Orb Prime, Primal Fangtooth and Shaper: six damn big objectives.
Greystone took 62807 damage, most of all ten, with 18994 healing, and killed Drongo three times.
Khaimera dead, a shit fight went 1-3, then Drongo razed the allied offlane outer and inner.
Iggy & Scorch died seven times, four to Wraith, three to Serath, against an own average under four.

focus.title: Cash every pick, never fight a body down
focus.action: Keep turning every pick into the next big objective or tower, and while Khaimera is dead, back off instead of fighting 4v5; Iggy & Scorch adds physical armor once Wraith gets a second kill.

17.9.call: Fangtooth went allied, then Wraith killed Khaimera at the pit, TwinBlast killed Phase and Serath killed Sparrow on the duo lane in the allied half. Greystone razed the enemy offlane outer in the same window and Mini Prime still went allied. After a pit take, the jungler and duo leave together.

22.5.call: Khaimera was dead when the fight opened: Serath killed Iggy & Scorch on the mid lane in the enemy half, Greystone killed Adele, and Sparrow and Phase fell on the duo lane, 1-3 overall. Drongo then razed the allied offlane outer, Khaimera's Fangtooth came after, and Drongo razed the allied offlane inner as well.

26.9.call: Khaimera took Orb Prime, then killed Wraith and Serath in the enemy jungle; the enemy mid inner, offlane inner and duo outer fell next, and Primal Fangtooth followed. Objective, picks, then towers is the order to repeat.

10edbf65-457d-48d0-9151-9df5b4fcb40a: Played the missing tank: 71703 mitigated, top among allies, plus last hits on the enemy offlane outer and second Mini Prime. Keep the tank build in tankless drafts.
The duo-lane kill on Adele was followed by Fangtooth, but both offlane towers fell to Drongo in the same stretch. Rotate once Drongo is dead or shown elsewhere.
a412baf3-dd17-4f89-8ecf-9d0704f3a79e: Ran the map: 65 enemy jungle minions, 28758 objective damage and last hits on three enemy structures, including the duo inhibitor. Keep invading whenever Serath shows on the far side.
Four deaths, three outside any detected fight: two to Serath, one to Wraith before the fight lost 1-3. With Wraith or Serath unseen, farm the allied jungle.
a0c393cc-1437-4bdc-8168-64676ce2166c: Carried the damage: 41939 at 1234 a minute against an own average of 919, plus the final kill on Serath before the Core fell. Repeat in every long game.

16f28434-561f-4f23-9454-40321f4a1ef3: Led all ten players with 34973 objective damage, and both kills on Drongo came on the offlane, the second followed by Orb Prime. Keep hitting towers after every won trade.
Hero damage ran 528 a minute against an own average of 853. In grouped fights, layer oil and fire on the choke before the enemy commits.
Against Wraith, dodge Peekaboo!, since Knock, Knock! hits marked targets harder, and expect a follow-up after a teleport back from the ultimate.

Kill participation sat at 32% with six assists. When Serath dives Sparrow, save Energy Lance for after Heaven's Fury ends, stacking the slow into a root.

threats: Enemy is 5/5 physical — a single armor item blunts most of their damage; itemize armor on anyone diveable.
Dive threat on our backline: Serath. Assign peel for the carry and ward the flanks.
synergy: Our engage/CC: Iggy & Scorch Inferno (knockback). Our kills come from landing burst INSIDE that CC window — whoever lands it, the rest must follow up immediately.
We have sustain (Phase) — favor the longer fight where our heals out-grind them.
Strong AoE/teamfight kit — group at choke points and fight on top of objectives.

ourKits.combo: Oil Spill to slow, Molotov to ignite the oil, Flame Turrets to keep shooting, then Inferno and its knockback belch.
ourKits.winCondition: Layer oil, fire and turrets on a choke or objective and burn the team that has to stand in it.
ourKits.passive: Badlands Critter basics stack Slick, a slow that lets his fire ignite the target.
ourKits.playWith: CC that holds enemies in his fire and oil.
ourKits.playAgainst: Do not fight in his oil and fire; flank around it. Melee basics break Flame Turrets quickly, and turrets go inactive when he moves away from them, so drag the fight off them; magical armor helps.

ourKits.combo: Telekinetic Link a carry, Psychic Flare around both of you to blind enemies facing it, Energy Lance to stack slows into a root, and Hyperflux to give both of you attack speed, ability haste and speed.
ourKits.winCondition: Power up a linked carry with the Link and Hyperflux and keep them healthy with Essence Catalyst healing.
ourKits.passive: Essence Catalyst: abilities heal her and her linked ally over time, and her Phase Blink has a shorter cooldown and boosts her damage.
ourKits.playWith: The strongest carry to Link, ideally one who wants attack speed and ability haste.
ourKits.playAgainst: Turn away from Psychic Flare, since it only blinds enemies facing it, and break Energy Lance's beam before it reaches the root. Anti-heal cuts the shared healing; focus the linked carry or force the Link out of range.

ourKits.combo: Piercing Shot poke → Heightened Senses for attack speed → Hail of Arrows slow → Inner Fire barrage
ourKits.winCondition: stack Relentless with basics and abilities to add max-health damage and melt the frontline in long fights
ourKits.passive: Relentless stacks on hit and makes her basics deal bonus max-health damage
ourKits.playWith: peel and a frontline, since her only escape is a short stealth
ourKits.playAgainst: Heightened Senses is her only escape, a brief stealth with speed and no dash, so hard-engage her after it is used; Piercing Shot passes through terrain, so do not hide behind walls at low health

ourKits.combo: Assault The Gates leap in, Make Way to shred armor, Sacred Oath empowered cleave to slow, then Stone Forged Soul to heal in Stasis and crash down.
ourKits.winCondition: Stay in the middle of fights and use Stone Forged Soul's missing-health heal to reset, while Make Way shreds armor for the team.
ourKits.passive: Stoicism deflects the next basic attack on a cooldown and grants health regen and armor that grow as he loses health.
ourKits.playWith: Damage dealers who can follow his leap and benefit from Make Way's armor shred.
ourKits.playAgainst: Do not burst into Stone Forged Soul's Stasis; step away from the slow and the crash, then re-engage. Open with an ability since Stoicism deflects a basic, and buy anti-heal to cut the ult heal.

ourKits.combo: Ambush leap and slow, Unleash for maximum attack speed cleaving basics, Cull to lock the target, Invigorate to cleanse and heal.
ourKits.winCondition: Stick to one target, build Rage for regen and faster cooldowns, and out-sustain them in long fights.
ourKits.passive: Ancestral Fury builds Rage on hits, giving health regen and faster cooldowns, plus movement speed at high Rage.
ourKits.playAgainst: Buy anti-heal to cut Invigorate and Rage regen. Save your CC until after Invigorate is used since it cleanses, and break off for a few seconds so his Rage decays.

enemyKits.combo: Old Rusty slows on the way out and back, Gag Grenade silences, Rad Rounds stacks Irradiate on basics, then Shrapnel Cannon shreds armor and erupts Irradiate
enemyKits.winCondition: kite from range, stack Wastelander bleed and Rad Rounds, and use Shrapnel Cannon to shred or escape
enemyKits.passive: critical strikes and ability hits apply a max-health bleed
enemyKits.playWith: peel and frontline so he can free-fire
enemyKits.playAgainst: dodge Gag Grenade's silence; Shrapnel Cannon cast in the air launches him away and is briefly unstoppable, so engage after it is used; armor blunts his physical damage

enemyKits.combo: Ascend to dive onto the backline, Chastise to slow and reset her basic attack, Heaven's Fury to go untargetable and strike, then Heresy for speed, attack speed and true-damage burns.
enemyKits.winCondition: Dive the backline, get the first takedown and chain free Heresy activations from Fallen Grace.
enemyKits.passive: Fallen Grace: hero takedowns drop a visage that, when touched, activates Heresy for free and cuts her basic ability cooldowns.
enemyKits.playWith: A frontline that creates her dive angle and CC that holds targets for her.
enemyKits.playAgainst: Do not waste CC or burst during Heaven's Fury, since she is invulnerable then; hit her as she lands from Ascend. Deny the first kill so she cannot pick up the visage.

enemyKits.combo: Vortex Grenade slow → Vaporize pierce → Rocket Dash reposition → Ventilate barrage
enemyKits.winCondition: weave abilities for Gunslinger triple-shots and keep Rocket Dash up by hitting heroes
enemyKits.passive: casting an ability grants attack speed and makes the next basic fire three times
enemyKits.playWith: a frontline that creates space for him to keep shooting
enemyKits.playAgainst: Rocket Dash is his only escape and comes back faster when he hits heroes, so engage right after he uses it; Ventilate is a short channel worth interrupting

enemyKits.combo: Imperial Lash roots and dashes her to the furthest hero hit, Royal Flourish spins to Mesmerize, then Queen's Garden leaps in to root and drop a slowing Thornbush, with Iron Rose cast mid-combo for damage reduction
enemyKits.winCondition: start fights with Lash or Queen's Garden and keep enemies stuck in the Thornbush while her Thorns make allies hit harder
enemyKits.passive: damaging enemy heroes applies Thorns, and allies deal bonus true damage to Thorned enemies
enemyKits.playWith: damage dealers who follow her engage and profit from Thorns bonus true damage
enemyKits.playAgainst: sidestep Imperial Lash, since without it she has to walk in; once Queen's Garden is down she has no big lockdown, and walking out of the Thornbush limits its damage and slow; tenacity helps against her chained root and Mesmerize

enemyKits.combo: Peekaboo! to mark, reveal and slow → Knock, Knock! snipe on the marked target → Back It Up! to drag a fleeing hero back
enemyKits.winCondition: land Knock, Knock! on Peekaboo!-marked targets for max-health damage and reset Surprise, Surprise! on takedowns
enemyKits.passive: his vision item becomes a camouflaged Sonar Drone that reveals enemies through walls
enemyKits.playWith: engage that holds targets still for his snipe, and teammates who follow up when Back It Up! returns a hero
enemyKits.playAgainst: dodge Peekaboo! since Knock, Knock! is much stronger on marked targets; after Back It Up! teleports you back, expect a follow-up, and pressure him after Surprise, Surprise! is spent

fedBy: Fallen Grace (passive): Takedowns on Enemy Heroes leave behind a demonic visage for 10s. Upon touching it, Serath activates Heresy at no cost and reduces her current basic ability cooldowns by 65%.
lines: Lead story: Hard to kill. Died 3 times in 34 minutes, fewer deaths than about 81% of Serath jungle players this patch. The build added health and armor and healing off damage.
Heresy at top rank: 85s base, about 68s by the end (20% shorter) from 25 ability haste: Spectra 10, Draconum 15.
12 takedowns (8 kills, 4 assists) fed: Draconum (Flow), Fallen Grace (passive).
Serath dealt 23,251 hero damage, 18% of their team's, with +155 physical power from items.
Sky Splitter (item): On Successful Basic Attacks: Deal 5% of Target's Current Health as Damage On-Hit. Reduced to 3.5% for Ranged Heroes. Minimum of 12 Damage.
Tainted Rounds (item): On Successful Basic Attacks: Reduce the Target's Healing by 45% for 3s. Deal (+10%) (+20%) Damage On-Hit. Increases by up to 100% as the Target's Health decreases.
Draconum (item): On dealing damage to Heroes or Monsters: Gain 2% increased Healing for 5s. Stacks up to 10 times.

Sustain: 7% lifesteal; Draconum: On dealing damage to Heroes or Monsters: Gain 2% increased Healing for 5s. Stacks up to 10 times.; Draconum: On Takedown: Restore (+120%)(+6%) Health.; Salvation: On going below 30% Health: Gain a (+25%) Shield for 6s. Reduced to 50% Effectiveness for Ranged Heroes. Gain 10% Omnivamp for 6s.; 12,648 healing recorded.
Toughness: +375 health, +40 physical armor, +25% tenacity; took 45,708 damage, mitigated 36,977, died 3 times.
Stack (Every basic attack set off): 3 effects on one trigger: Sky Splitter, Tainted Rounds, Spectra.
Stack (Healing off the damage): 3 effects on one trigger: Sky Splitter, Draconum, Salvation.
Countered? 1 of the 3 players Serath killed built physical armor (Khaimera). Anti-heal on Iggy & Scorch, Sparrow, Greystone. We killed Serath 3 times.
Copy it? Too few Serath jungle games with this Eternal or core this patch to say whether it wins elsewhere.

lines: Lead story: Damage well above normal. 1,460 hero damage a minute, more than 88% of Wraith mid players this patch (39% of the team's). The damage came from Alternata, The Perforator, Tainted Trident.
Back It Up! at top rank: 95s base, about 61.3s by the end (35% shorter) from 55 ability haste: Alternata 10, The Perforator 15, Tainted Trident 10, Spear Of Desolation 10, Infernum 10.
Spear Of Desolation (Final Hour): On casting your Ultimate: Deal 10% increased damage for 6s.
Spear Of Desolation (Razor's Edge): Gain 25 Ultimate Haste.
Wraith dealt 49,627 hero damage, 39% of their team's, with +230 physical power from items.

Penetration: Alternata 12, The Perforator 8, Tainted Trident 11, Spear Of Desolation 12, Infernum 9, The Perforator ignores 30%; against Iggy & Scorch (level 17 estimated: about 95 physical armor, 15 after penetration) and Khaimera (level 17 estimated: about 188 physical armor, 79 after penetration) that is about 70% and 60% more damage (estimate: percent penetration taken before flat).
Alternata (item): Your Alternate Ability deals 15% more damage.
The Perforator (item): On dealing Ability Damage: Slows by 10% for 1s.
Tainted Trident (item): On dealing Physical Damage: Reduce the Target's Healing by 45% for 3s.
Tainted Trident (item): On dealing Ability Damage to a Blighted Unit: Deal 3 (+6%)% additional Damage.
Spear Of Desolation (item): On casting your Ultimate: Deal 10% increased damage for 6s.
Infernum (item): Damaging Abilities and Basic Attacks: Apply stacks of Kindling to Enemy Units for 2.5s. At 4 stacks, ignite them. Deals 4 (+1.5%)% of their Max Health as Damage over 2s.
Infernum (item): Based on Enemy Bonus Armor: For each point, Cinder deals 0.8% more Damage.

Lesson: Wraith's penetration cut through: Iggy & Scorch took about 70% more physical damage than their armor alone allows (estimate: at level 17 (estimated) their armor was about 95, about 15 after 52 flat + 30% penetration).

Stack (Every ability hit set off): 2 effects on one trigger: The Perforator, Tainted Trident. Wraith has 2 damaging abilities, and 55 ability haste brought them back 35% sooner: more casts, more triggers.
Stack (Kept alive in fights): 2 effects on one trigger: The Perforator, Infernum. Together they made staying in a long fight cheaper: more armor, shields or healing the longer it went.
Countered? 2 of the 3 players Wraith killed built physical armor (Khaimera, Greystone). Anti-heal on Iggy & Scorch, Sparrow, Greystone. We killed Wraith 3 times.
Copy it? Too few Wraith midlane games with this Eternal or core this patch to say whether it wins elsewhere.

bullets: Chastise reset Serath's basic attack cooldown, so an extra basic attack fired Sky Splitter and Tainted Rounds between abilities, and every hit stacked Draconum's increased healing.
Weald fired true-damage missiles when Serath damaged a hero below 30% health (10s cooldown per hero); Wind-Rider added attack speed after the Heaven's Fury teleport.
Forage added gold and experience on each minion or monster kill, and Crushing Descent made Ascend's dive briefly stun every enemy the dive damaged.
Peekaboo! marked targets, so the next Knock, Knock! dealt bonus max-health magical damage with a 75% cooldown cut; Alternata gave Knock, Knock! 15% more damage.
Xyris added bonus damage growing with units killed, up to a cap; Cull the Weak hit minions and monsters harder; Furor gave attack speed on entering hero combat.
Each ability hit set off The Perforator's slow, any physical hit applied Tainted Trident's healing cut, and Sniper's Bounty paid extra gold for Knock, Knock! killing blows.
Endless Hunt reset Piercing Shot, Hail of Arrows and Heightened Senses on every takedown and permanently added physical penetration, so each takedown readied every basic ability again.
Weald fired true-damage missiles when Sparrow damaged a hero below 30% health (per-hero cooldown); Wind-Rider added attack speed after leaving Heightened Senses' stealth; Forage added farm gold.
Every basic attack fed Lightning Hawk's Momentum toward an empowered slowing shot and applied Tainted Rounds' healing cut, with Tainted Rounds' damage rising as the target's health fell.
Forticus shielded Greystone on taking hero damage, on a cooldown, while Stoicism's regeneration and armor rose with missing health and regeneration doubled below 50% health.
Krix raised max health, which made Stone Forged Soul's max-health heal bigger; Cannibalism added max health per takedown; Regenerative Tissue healed only after time without hero damage.
Imperial Soul made Stone Forged Soul hit 12% harder with a 20% larger radius; Overlord splashed damage around each basic attack's target, and Rapture added close-range on-hit damage.
